ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with high-contrast localized white clusters; estimated 85:15 ratio of dark to light pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black base layer across both lobes. High-contrast white pixel clusters are concentrated at the distal tips. Discrete, circular high-intensity blobs are scattered across the interior of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central indentation with an estimated 50-degree internal angle and a depth approximately 1/5th of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated trailing edge with frequent low-amplitude (3-10 pixel) peaks and valleys, more pronounced towards the outer lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinctly concave curve extending from the median notch to the lateral apex of each lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-20 pixels in diameter) consistent with barnacle attachment sites, distributed primarily across the mid-section of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, white linear pixel disruptions; specifically, a cluster of diagonal rake marks visible on the inner right lobe near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface scarring composed of circular rosette marks and multiple linear abrasions across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-intensity white mottling patterns isolated at the extreme outer margins of the left and right fluke tips.
